summary: Frontend-only regression test of the redesigned Settings 'Perfil atual' card and new Home hero illustration. All requested flows pass: hero image loads (naturalWidth 848, static.prod-images.emergentagent.com URL, descriptive pt-BR alt) and looks good in light and dark themes; profile card shows avatar/name/email/role tag on separate labelled rows (Nome/E-mail/Tipo de perfil) with no overflow at 1920 and 390 widths, including Extra grande font and a long name/email (overflow-wrap works); change-role toggles Aluno<->Professor, updates role tag, button label and sidebar chip, and enables/disables Soluções nav; settings-manage-account opens auth modal, registration updates card name+email, logout returns to Visitante, admin@viva.app login works (Administrador / Professor). Regression: toggle-tts, toggle-motion (data-reduce-animations), toggle-theme (data-theme), sidebar theme-toggle, image-model-select (persists after reload) and note creation all work.

ui_bugs.issue: Extra grande only sets --font-scale on .viva-shell, but almost every element (including profile card dd 12px, dt 9px, role-tag 10px, small 10px) has a hardcoded px font-size, so the setting barely changes text size (profile name stays 12px at Extra grande). This bug existed before this change, but it matters for an accessibility-focused app.

issues: Labels are 9px and helper text is 10px, which is very small for an accessibility app; consider using rem/em units tied to --font-scale
Toggle buttons have no role='switch'/aria-checked, so screen readers cannot tell their state (minor a11y)

action_items: Optional: switch the hardcoded px font sizes (at least in the profile card and settings) to em/rem so font-size-select really scales the text
Optional: add role='switch' and aria-checked to SettingRow toggles
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is one 241-line file with very long single-line components (Home, SettingsView, Notes), which makes it hard to maintain; consider splitting it into component files
--font-scale is applied only via inheritance, but App.css overrides it almost everywhere with px values
